program.description: {product} — a self-hosted AI assistant that belongs to your group
option.dir: the install folder (default: search upward for {configFile})
option.json: print one JSON document and never prompt
option.nonInteractive: never prompt; fail with exit 3 if something is missing
version.description: Print the {product} version and the runtime it is on
exitCodes.description: List what each exit code means
keys.description: Encryption keys: status, verification and rotation
keys.status.description: Show the key source, the keyring's generations and what needs attention
keys.status.recoverySlots: recovery slots on the current generation: {count}
keys.status.rotateAdvisory: This keyring has wrapped {wraps} values, past the {advisory} advisory. Run `{cli} keys rotate-data`.
keys.verify.description: Check a recovery key against this keyring. Changes nothing
keys.verify.option.file: read the key from a file instead of asking
keys.verify.option.gen: check against one generation rather than all of them
keys.verify.ok: That is the recovery key for this {product} (generation {gen}, slot {slotId}).
keys.verify.fail: That is not the recovery key for this install.
keys.rotateMaster.description: Replace the master key. Every generation keeps working
keys.rotateMaster.consequence: The old key stops working as soon as this finishes.
keys.rotateRecovery.description: Print a new recovery key and replace the old one
keys.rotateRecovery.option.out: also write the new key to a file
keys.rotateRecovery.consequence: The current recovery key stops working, and it is never shown again.
keys.rotateRecovery.rewrap: Old backups still need the previous key until you run `{cli} backup rewrap --all`.
keys.rotateRecovery.abandoned: The new recovery key was not confirmed, so nothing was changed.
keys.recover.description: Use the recovery key to establish a new master key (08 §3.7.8)
keys.recover.unchanged: Your recovery key is unchanged and still the only off-host way in. If it may have been seen, run `{cli} keys rotate-recovery`.
keys.addPassphrase.description: Add a passphrase as a third way to unlock this install (08 §3.7.8)
keys.addPassphrase.unattended: A host that unlocks with a passphrase cannot start unattended — there is nobody to type it after a reboot.
keys.removeSlot.description: Remove one unlock route from a generation
keys.removeSlot.argument: the slot to remove, as `keys status` lists it
keys.removeSlot.option.gen: which generation the slot is on
keys.removeSlot.consequence: That unlock route stops working. The keyring refuses to leave a generation with no recovery slot, so this cannot lock you out entirely.
keys.purge.option.blobs: confirm every blob has been rewrapped onto the current key
keys.purge.none: There are no retired generations to purge.
keys.purge.consequence: A retired generation is what opens blobs and backups made under it. This cannot be undone, and no recovery key brings them back.
option.insecurePermissions: proceed even if the key file is group- or world-readable
error.noInstall.hint: Run `{cli} init` to create one, or pass `--dir <path>` (or set {dirVar}) to point at an existing one.
error.noKeyring.hint: Run `{cli} init` to set this install up, or point `--data-dir` at an existing data directory.
error.missingInput: {what} is required and this run cannot prompt for it.
error.missingInput.hint: Pass {flag}, or run without --non-interactive in a terminal.
error.recoveryKeyRequired: The recovery key is required and this run cannot ask for it.
error.recoveryKeyRequired.hint: Pass `--recovery-key-file <path>`, or pipe the key on stdin. It is never accepted as a flag value, because that would put it in your shell history.
error.recoveryKeyEmpty.hint: Run the command again and type the key {product} printed at setup.
error.fileUnreadable.hint: Check the path and that this user can read it.
error.passphraseFileUnreadable: {variable} points at {path}, which could not be read.
error.passphrase.interactive: Run this in a terminal: a passphrase is never accepted as a flag value, because that would put it in your shell history.
error.keyPermissions.hint: Fix the modes, or pass `--insecure-permissions` to proceed anyway (ssh-style).
error.keyStoreReadOnly: This install reads its master key from {store}, which {cli} cannot write.
error.keyStoreReadOnly.hint: The new key was printed to stderr by the operation that made it. Put it where {store} mode reads from, then run `{cli} keys status`.
error.unexpected.hint: This is a bug. The log is in your data directory under logs/.
error.confirmNonInteractive.hint: {consequence} Pass `--yes` to confirm without being asked.
ceremony.writeDown: Write this down. {product} will never show it again:
ceremony.written: Also written to {path} (mode 0600). Move it off this host.
ceremony.nonInteractive: A new recovery key cannot be confirmed in a non-interactive run.
ceremony.nonInteractive.hint: Pass `--recovery-key-out <path>` so the key is written somewhere you chose, or run this in a terminal.
